utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might shift a bit this week—have you seen the latest schedule?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet — can you confirm what changed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t seen the final update yet, just that there may be a time shift this week. I’ll check and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring it up with the others and make sure the carpool plan is clear.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll circle back with everyone and let you know the plan as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d say be ready by 7:15—we can head out right after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll be ready by 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Cleo, I’m in for the carpool if you still need one more.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Rey — we’ve got you down.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, just send me the pickup time and place.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Jules — I’m sorting out the school drop-off this week. What time works best for your carpool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Morning works best for me — I can do around 8:00 if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8:00 works great for me too. I’ll plan on that for drop-off this week.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—what time do you want the carpool to leave, and who’s riding with us?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I’m thinking around 7:30 works for me, and I can probably bring Sam and Mia if they’re still in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7:30 sounds good to me. I’ll count on Sam and Mia unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can spread the word and see who wants in for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be great—could you also ask what time everyone needs to leave so I can figure out the pickup order?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing — I’ll ask everyone what time they need to leave and get back to you so you can sort the pickup order.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the carpool plan changed—did I get that right? If so, tell me what time and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, the plan changed—let’s meet at 7:30 by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, 7:30 by the community center entrance—thanks for the update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the pickup time and address? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll send you the pickup time and address right now so you can check them before committing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll look for it and confirm once I’ve checked the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can help with the carpool. Just let me know the pickup time and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll text you the pickup time and address once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if you need a ride for the carpool, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What time are you leaving?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m planning to leave around 7:30, so I can swing by a little before that if needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of that — what time and pickup spot should I note for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s say 7:30 at the front gate, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — 7:30 at the front gate. I’ll note it and keep an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need it — what are you figuring out?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’m just trying to sort out the schedule and who can ride when. If you’re still up for it, I could use your help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’m happy to help sort the schedule and figure out who can ride when.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing—what time are we leaving, and who’s picking everyone up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm the pickup order and exact departure time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check the pickup order, but I still need the exact departure time before I can say for sure. Once I have that, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara — I can help coordinate the carpool if you want. Do you already know who needs a ride?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — I don’t have the full list yet, but I know a few folks may need rides. I’ll check and send you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — send it over when you have it, and I’ll help sort out the rides.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of who’s bringing what for the carpool. Just let me know the pickup times and any supplies we should have ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll probably be running a little late, but I’ll send my pickup time and what I’m bringing soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just send it when you can, and I’ll make sure everything’s noted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on for this week, but the pickup time might shift a little. I’ll pass along anything I hear right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Just let me know as soon as the pickup time is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time do we need to be ready?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’m thinking we should be ready by 7:15 so we can leave by 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll be ready by 7:15 and waiting to leave at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time are we thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning would work best for me, around 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me — I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m putting together the carpool and wanted to see if you’d like a spot. If you’re in, I can send the details over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks Quinn — that’d be great. I’m in, so send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send them over right away, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the pickup spot and time—what address should I note for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s use 214 Maple Street. Pickups can be at 7:30 sharp, and I’ll be ready out front.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note 214 Maple Street for 7:30 sharp, out front.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — let me double-check and I’ll confirm right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana — just let me know when you’ve confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the carpool timing shifted a bit—are we still good for the usual pickup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for the reminder — I’m pretty sure we’re still good, just a little later than usual. I’ll double-check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just let me know the exact time when you check.
